# Apollo 12's Lunar Reunion

Put on red/blue glasses to see astronaut Pete Conrad standing beside the robotic Surveyor 3 spacecraft on the Moon in 1969—a remarkable achievement that brought together two machines from Earth that had landed at the same spot separated by more than two years. This three-dimensional image was created from two Moon-surface photographs taken from slightly different angles, mimicking how your two eyes work together to perceive depth, allowing you to experience the stark lunar landscape as the astronaut did.
